name: Petrofac
description: International energy-services company (est. 1981, 8,500 staff, 30+ offices) designing, building, managing and maintaining oil, gas, refining and new-energies infrastructure, plus training services. UNDER ADMINISTRATION since 28 Oct 2025 (joint administrators appointed over Petrofac Limited); Petrofac Emirates sold to a Mason Capital-led consortium (May 2026) and a new board announced Jul 2026 - record kept for the reference base and historical projects.

sources.note: Vendor site, read 2026-10-29 (administration notice in footer)
